profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tagomi
profile.summary:
Over ten years of systems analysis and application development experience, specializing in leading the design and development of web based business solutions that leverage Microsoft tools and technologies such as ASP.NET MVC, Web Api, C# and SQL Server as well as other open source technologies like Django, Python and PostgreSql.

In-depth knowledge of using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and updated with the latest web development technologies and best practices.

Experience leading teams of designers and developers in the delivery of cutting-edge interactive web based, mobile, and/or desktop applications.

Exposure to creating UI standards and guidelines for large-scale application design and in planning/conducting usability testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built, tested and shipped customer facing features/products using modern tools for a reliable, secure and high-performant crypto trading platform.
• Worked closely with the development team and other groups like product, business analyst, quality assurance, and project management resources throughout delivery of solutions.
• Completed complex development, design, implementation, architecture design specification, and maintenance activities

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Took ownership of the overall architecture and development of highly scalable ReactJS frontend frameworks.
• Used best programming practices and knowledge of web development to create innovative API driven solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Translated visual and user-centered design specifications and business requirements into functional, standards compliant websites and web applications that generated revenue, increased productivity, or minimized ongoing costs.
• Implemented middle-layer and backend enhancements to websites designed to create functionality, improve site performance and identify key metric points.
• Created technical development plans and lead the development of standards compliant code for web applications using the latest Microsoft technologies.
• Actively adapted to changing technology needs and frameworks to best serve the technical and business needs of the organization. 
• Collaborated with other technology departments to define development and production infrastructure needs and best practices.
• Created technical documentation and code comments based on industry standards.
• Worked on multiple concurrent projects and participated in the entire software development lifecycle.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Supported existing ASP.NET, ASP.NET MVC, VB.NET, C# and developed new applications
• Worked with SQL Server to create tables, views and stored procedures
• Worked with report writers to create reports and integrate into web and desktop applications
• Created technical documentation (flow charts, data dictionary, user guides)

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed, tested and documented several modules for an enterprise solution using ASP.NET, SQL Server, Entity Framework, DotNetNuke and Telerik Controls for ASP.NET AJAX.
•	Improved performance of the solution by applying several algorithms and advanced data structures.

positions.title: Web Development
positions.description:
•	Programmed a cross-browser compatible web based application for managing the services, customers and employees at the center using CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript, Jquery, Bootstrap, Django, MySQL
•	Developed a new database and implementing improvements for case management saving more than 70% of the manual labour and a lot of time of the employees
•	Developed simple reports using bar and pie charts using several Javascript libraries 
•	Provided technical support and training to the employees of the center

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and developed a website that allowed access to an online game platform using CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript, Jquery, Bootstrap, Django, CodeIgniter and SQLITE
•	Design, creation and implementation of gaming application software for different platforms like Windows, Linux and Android utilizing skills in Qt, QML, XNA, Monogame, LibGDX
•	Proposed new algorithms for improving the performance of the communication protocol used by videogames
•	Proposed and implemented innovative ideas such as adding a chat and a ranking system to improve communication and stimulate players’ participation 
•	Lead a team of designers, UX and creative teams to build highly efficient, user-friendly interfaces in a fast paced environment
•	Plan and conduct co-design and ideation workshops 
•	Gathered the functional and no-functional requirements of the system
•	Developed low- fidelity and high fidelity wireframes 
•	Design and conduct quantitative and qualitative user research activities 
•	Develop user personas, scenarios and journey maps 
•	Develop and implement UX strategy from start to finish 
•	Create UI standards and guidelines for large-scale application design

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	As a team member developed a fleet management software for an automatic tracking system according to the client’s needs using C#, Qt(C++)
•	Installed and configured a map server using GeoServer
•	Created and designed different applications which were sold to Spain
•	Worked as a UI developer
•	Functioned as Software analyst using RUP, XP and SCRUM Methodology

positions.title: Network Administrator
positions.description:
•	Responsible for creating standards and guidelines for infrastructure and application design in a multi project environment
•	Analysis of multiple software platforms and recommend the best software/technology for the project teams
•	In charge of the network administration of the center and responsible for ensuring a healthy infrastructure for a multi team application development environment by ensuring up-to-date software updates and security patches
•	Maintained all servers and user systems ensuring they were updated and operative

positions.title: University of Informatic Sciences
positions.description:
•	Proposed a tool to decode wireless information frames that was later implemented 
•	Developed a system for creating libraries dynamically, saving a lot of time and labour for the programmers 
•	Installed and configured a Control Version System Server improving the coordination of the team

honors.description: Software Development: Periodic Table of the Chemical Elements
honors.issuer: Issued by Japan Institute of Invention and Innovations · Jan 2004
